tasks.short: Research new financial products and judge their usefulness.

steps.what: Extract the terms of the new financial products.

loop.input: Term sheets for the new financial products
loop.output: Rows for payoff, date, underlying and fee
loop.check: The analyst checks each payoff against the term sheet line
loop.stop: One pass; a term that is prose stays blank
loop.why_not_simpler: Term sheets mix tables and narrative, so a fixed map misses payoffs

steps.what: Price the financial products on the house model.
Judge the usefulness of the new financial products' analytics.
Draft the usefulness recommendation for the financial products.

loop.input: The usefulness judgement and the model price
loop.output: A recommendation that cites only those two
loop.check: The analyst deletes a claim that is not in the judgement
loop.stop: One pass; a claim with no judgement line is removed
loop.why_not_simpler: The recommendation has to follow the judgement, not invent a new one

steps.what: Present the usefulness judgement to the desk.

tasks.design: Terms are extracted from the product sheet, and the house model prices them. The analyst judges usefulness for this book. The recommendation may say only what that judgement says, and the desk presentation stays with the analyst.
tasks.previous_blocker: Usefulness was argued from a term sheet nobody had priced on the house model.
tasks.enabler_now: Extraction and a house price are feasible once terms are named. Judging usefulness for this book cannot.
tasks.still_hard: A product whose payoff the house model does not contain.
tasks.human_edge: The analyst knows when a price is not the same thing as usefulness.
tasks.altitude: Prices are ready before the judgement. The analyst still decides usefulness and can refuse a recommendation that goes beyond it. Decision rights do not move.

reach.task: Say which product features a client would treat as useful
reach.learn: Which usefulness claims do not survive a client conversation

evidence.claim: Judging whether a new product is useful for a book stays with the analyst.
In a published spreadsheet-agent test, most models ended a cash waterfall at €1.16 million, not €580,000.

assumptions: Focal role is the quantitative analyst. Boundary: from a product sheet to a desk presentation. Issuing the product is outside this task.
Structured fields are payoff, date, underlying, model price and judgement. The term sheet produces the payoff; the analyst writes the judgement. Fallback: a term that stays blank is not priced.
Configure the house price on {DATA_PLATFORM} before custom code.
Upkeep of 4 hours per 100 baseline hours covers a new payoff field.
unknowns: Whether the house model already prices this payoff type.
Whether the desk expects a recommendation or only a price.
research_questions: What share of terms extract cleanly from the sheet?
How often is a priced product judged not useful?

incremental.description: Add a payoff field when a new product type appears

approvals.approved_version: usefulness judgement the analyst presented for these financial products

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: the payoff is not in the house model, so extraction does not help and the judgement is unchanged. High: terms and a price exist and only those shrink. Usefulness and the presentation stay.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Track trading system metrics and investigate an unexplained break.

steps.what: Set thresholds for trading system operations metrics.
Compute trading system operations metrics on the latest run.
Page when a trading metric crosses a threshold already set.
Investigate a trading system break the threshold cannot explain.

tasks.design: The analyst sets the thresholds, and {BI} computes the trading system metrics on each run. A page goes out only when a metric crosses a threshold already set. An unexplained break stays with the analyst.
tasks.previous_blocker: Metrics were assembled after the run, so a breach was seen at the weekly review.
tasks.enabler_now: A metric with a stored definition can be computed, and a page can use a threshold the analyst has set. Explaining a break the threshold does not cover cannot.
tasks.still_hard: A break in a part of the run the metric does not see.
tasks.human_edge: The analyst knows when a breach is a bad run and when the threshold is wrong.

ambition.what: An operations break is investigated the morning it appears, not at the weekly review.

tasks.altitude: Metrics are current each morning. The analyst still sets thresholds and can ignore a page that is not a real break. Decision rights on the threshold do not move.

reach.task: Say which operational metrics also indicate an access problem
reach.learn: Which trading-system breaks should be passed to security

evidence.claim: Computing a defined operations metric is a rules task once the threshold and the run log exist.
Investigating a break a threshold cannot explain stays with the analyst.

assumptions: Focal role is the quantitative analyst. Boundary: from a metric definition to a break finding. Changing the trading system is outside this task.
Structured fields are metric, threshold, run id and value. The analyst sets the threshold; the run log produces the value. Fallback: a metric with no threshold is computed but not paged.
Configure the metric on {BI} before custom code.
Upkeep of 6 hours per 100 baseline hours covers a new metric added to the run.
unknowns: Whether run logs already contain the fields the metrics need.
Whether a page is read the same morning.
research_questions: What share of runs breach a threshold?
How often is a page not a real break?

incremental.description: Add a metric when the trading system gains a step

approvals.approved_version: thresholds the analyst set for these trading metrics before this run

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: most breaches need a person, so the page saves little and the investigation stays. High: thresholds are stable and only the compute shrinks. Setting thresholds and unexplained breaks stay.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Choose governance issues, score disclosed figures, and publish the method.

steps.what: Choose the environmental, social and governance issues to measure.
Extract disclosed corporate figures for those governance issues.

loop.input: Company disclosures and the issues the analyst chose
loop.output: Rows for issue, figure, year and page
loop.check: The analyst checks a figure against the disclosure page
loop.stop: One pass; a figure with no page stays blank
loop.why_not_simpler: Disclosures mix tables and narrative, so a fixed map misses figures

steps.what: Score corporate performance with the method already chosen.
Judge a disclosure that does not fit the governance method.
Publish the environmental method note the analyst has checked.

tasks.design: The analyst chooses the environmental, social and governance issues. Disclosed figures are extracted, and a score uses only the method already chosen. A disclosure that does not fit stays a judgement, and the method note is published only after the analyst checks it.
tasks.previous_blocker: Scores were applied to whatever a disclosure happened to contain, so a blank was treated as a zero.
tasks.enabler_now: Extraction and a score are feasible once the issues and the method are chosen. Choosing the issues, and reading a disclosure that does not fit, cannot.
tasks.still_hard: A company whose disclosure does not use the chosen issues.
tasks.human_edge: The analyst knows when a missing figure is a gap and when it is not applicable.

ambition.what: A disclosure that does not fit the method is judged when it arrives, not only at the annual review.

tasks.altitude: Scores wait on the chosen method. The analyst still chooses the issues and can hold the note. Decision rights on the method do not move.

reach.task: Say which disclosed figures an inspection will ask to see
reach.learn: Which environmental figures must have a page reference

evidence.claim: Choosing which environmental, social and governance issues to measure stays with the analyst.
Scoring a company's disclosure is not credit scoring of a natural person under annex III 5(b); firms fall outside that duty and sole traders do not.

assumptions: Focal role is the quantitative analyst. Boundary: from a measurement question to a published method note. Engaging a company on its disclosure is outside this task.

Structured fields are issue, figure, year, page and method id. The analyst chooses the issue; the disclosure produces the figure. Fallback: a figure with no page is left blank and is not scored as zero.
Configure the score on {SPREADSHEET} before custom code.
Upkeep of 5 hours per 100 baseline hours covers an issue added to the method.
The method scores companies, not natural persons.
unknowns: Whether disclosures are available as text with page numbers.
Whether the method note is published outside the firm.
research_questions: What share of chosen issues have a page-referenced figure?
How often is a disclosure judged not to fit the method?

incremental.description: Add an issue when the method's questions change

approvals.approved_version: method note the analyst checked against the chosen issues and the scores

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: disclosures are not page-referenced, so extraction is manual and the method choice is unchanged. High: figures extract and only the score shrinks. Choosing issues and misfit judgements stay.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Model quantitative structured solutions and say what must change.

steps.what: Hear the product team on the expanded markets.
Model the quantitative structured solutions for the expanded markets.

loop.input: The heard market and the house library of payoffs
loop.output: A payoff description using only library components
loop.check: The analyst rejects a component the library does not contain
loop.stop: Stop when every component is in the library or listed as missing
loop.why_not_simpler: Market briefs are prose, so a fixed payoff template misses the structure

steps.what: Validate the structured payoff on the historical book.
Say what must change before the structured solutions are offered.
Rewrite the term sheet for the expanded markets.

tasks.design: The analyst hears the expanded market, then models the structured payoff from the house library. {DATA_PLATFORM} validates it on the historical book. Saying what must change stays with the analyst; rewriting the term sheet is the product developer's work.
tasks.previous_blocker: The payoff was sketched in the meeting, so validation waited on a one-off file.
tasks.enabler_now: A payoff made of library components can be validated on a historical book. Hearing the market, and saying what must change, cannot.
tasks.still_hard: A market whose payoff is not in the library.
tasks.human_edge: The analyst knows when a historical pass still leaves the market unserved.
tasks.altitude: Validation is ready after the model. The analyst still hears the market and can block an offer. Decision rights on the change list do not move.

reach.task: Say which structured payoffs change an insurance exposure
reach.learn: Which expanded markets create an insurance-like risk

evidence.claim: Saying what must change before a structured product is offered stays with the analyst.
Validating a payoff on a historical book is a rules run once the components are named.

assumptions: Focal role is the quantitative analyst. The product developer's rewrite is not the analyst's saving. Boundary: from a market conversation to a change list. Selling the product is outside this task.

Structured fields are component, market, historical result and change. The library produces the component; the analyst writes the change. Fallback: a component the library does not contain is listed as missing and is not validated.
Configure the historical validation on {DATA_PLATFORM} before custom code.
Upkeep of 4 hours per 100 baseline hours covers a library component added for a new market.
unknowns: Whether the house library already contains these payoff components.
Whether the product developer is a different person.
research_questions: What share of heard markets use only library components?
How often does a historical pass still produce a change?

incremental.description: Add a library component for a new market

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: the payoff is not in the library, so validation does not run and the conversation is unchanged. High: components exist and only the historical run shrinks. Hearing the market and the change list stay. Product-developer time is not saved.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The week is still judging usefulness, setting metric thresholds and choosing which issues to measure. Prices, metric runs and disclosed figures are ready beforehand. The analyst can hold a recommendation, a page or a method note.
reach: Personal financial advisors: say which product features a client would treat as useful
Environmental compliance inspectors: say which disclosed figures an inspection will ask to see
Insurance underwriters: say which structured payoffs change an insurance exposure
skills_to_grow: Separating a model price from usefulness for this book
Leaving a metric unpaged when no threshold is set
Leaving a disclosed figure blank instead of scoring it as zero
role.ambitious_version: Every usefulness claim cites a judgement, every page uses a threshold set earlier, and every environmental score cites a page in the disclosure.
